captionLines: The People of the State of New York, Respondent,
dateLines: Appeal, by permission of a Justice of the Appellate Division of the Supreme Court in the First Judicial Department, from an order of that Court, entered September 19, 2024. The Appellate Division affirmed a judgment of the Supreme Court, New York County (Laura A. Ward, J., at suppression hearing; Daniel Conviser, J., at plea and sentencing), which had convicted defendant, upon a plea of guilty, of criminal sale of a controlled substance in the third degree and criminal possession of a controlled substance in the third degree.

qualifierLines: {**44 NY3d at 1037} OPINION OF THE COURT

The Appellate Division affirmed the subsequent judgment of conviction, with one Justice dissenting (230 AD3d 1009 [1st Dept 2024]). The dissenting Justice granted defendant leave to appeal (42 NY3d 1055 [2024]).
